stemMd: A grant committee funds only proposals that have both a feasibility report and a named project lead. Proposal Sable has no named lead. Which conclusion must be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The committee funds every other proposal.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every proposal with a lead will be funded.

options.label: D
options.textMd: No proposal with a feasibility report is funded.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Proposal Sable will not be funded under the stated rule.

explanationMd: A named lead is necessary for funding. Its absence rules out funding regardless of the feasibility report, while leaving unrelated proposals unresolved.

distractorRationale.b: A lead is necessary but not sufficient.
distractorRationale.d: The report is required, not disqualifying.
distractorRationale.a: No outcomes for other proposals are specified.
distractorRationale.c: The missing lead does not establish the report’s status.
